tips.title: Weather
tips.body: December in Manila is warm and mostly dry. Pack light clothes and a light jacket for air-conditioned venues.

tips.title: Getting around
tips.body: Traffic can be heavy. Follow bus call times; [transport details to follow].

tips.title: What to bring
tips.body: Company ID, valid government ID, chargers, comfortable walking shoes, [more to follow].

tips.title: Money
tips.body: Carry some cash in pesos; most malls and restaurants accept cards.

contact.line: For questions or concerns, please feel free to reach out to the Corporate Communications Group.

journey.title: Arrival
journey.blurb: Everyone in Manila by December 3, from every branch.

journey.title: Royu Tour
journey.blurb: A plant tour for those who registered: two runs a day, December 3 and 4.
